summary: Practise psychological safety, inclusive decisions, and equitable feedback. Build team diagnostics and action plans in this five-day course.
lede: Inclusive leadership and psychological safety help leaders create team routines where people can raise concerns and contribute. Designed for senior managers, team leaders, and HR business partners, the course addresses how to assess and strengthen participation in diverse or hybrid teams. You will practise spotting micro-inequities, structuring inclusive decisions, giving equitable feedback, and interpreting team inclusion signals.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who shape team climate, decision processes, and employee experience in diverse or hybrid teams.
prerequisites: Prior experience leading teams or supporting managers is recommended. No coding or programming is required. You can bring anonymized team examples for practice, but the exercises do not require organizational data.
